 "content": "from collections import Counter


def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    row_lines = [i for i, row in enumerate(grid) if len(set(row)) == 1]
    col_lines = [j for j in range(w) if len({grid[i][j] for i in range(h)}) == 1]
    # A lattice divider is a full monochrome row/column. Use the color shared
    # by these dividers, and infer the unmarked output color from the cells.
    divider_colors = [grid[i][0] for i in row_lines] + [grid[0][j] for j in col_lines]
    divider = Counter(divider_colors).most_common(1)[0][0]
    values = [grid[i][j] for i in range(h) for j in range(w) if grid[i][j] != divider]
    base = Counter(values).most_common(1)[0][0]
    rb = [-1] + row_lines + [h]
    cb = [-1] + col_lines + [w]
    out = []
    for ri in range(len(rb) - 1):
        line = []
        for ci in range(len(cb) - 1):
            r0, r1 = rb[ri] + 1, rb[ri + 1]
            c0, c1 = cb[ci] + 1, cb[ci + 1]
            n = sum(grid[r][c] == 5 for r in range(r0, r1) for c in range(c0, c1))
            line.append(1 if n > 1 else base)
        out.append(line)
    return out
